title: Workspace-scoped AppContainer filesystem authority qualification
objective: Qualify the minimum stable-Windows filesystem authority required for a zero-capability AppContainer child to read and write only within an explicitly trusted workspace, while preserving denial of Cotra protected state, unrelated user resources, network capability, and authority-channel inheritance. This is a provider-private qualification grain and must not expose new public PowerShell or process authority.

include: stable Windows security primitives for workspace-scoped AppContainer filesystem access
explicit read and write qualification inside that workspace
negative access qualification for a test-owned sibling resource outside the workspace
SG-000012 protected-state and authority-channel isolation regressions
existing suspended launch, token verification, Job membership, bounded I/O, timeout, and verified termination invariants
exclude: caller-selected ACL targets or security descriptors
caller-provided environment overrides or stdin payloads
process network authority or PowerShell remoting
approval bypass or persistent approval reuse
experimental CreateProcessInSandbox or Bound File System as the production baseline

authority_delta.filesystem: Provider-private qualification only: minimum AppContainer access to one explicit test-owned trusted workspace; no public authority delta.
authority_delta.process: None; no new public executable or PowerShell authority.
authority_delta.network: None; zero AppContainer network capabilities remain mandatory.
authority_delta.secrets: None; Cotra/tunnel/API secret-like values and protected state remain unavailable.

invariants: Public powershell.run remains absent throughout this grain
Windows public process.spawn remains restricted to the exact SG-000010-qualified System32 whoami.exe target
Workspace authority is granted only to an explicit test-owned trusted workspace and never to the user profile or arbitrary caller-selected paths
A contained child can read and write inside the qualified workspace only after the workspace grant is established
A contained child remains denied access to a test-owned sibling resource outside the workspace and to Cotra protected state
The cotra-mcp to cotrad authority channel and caller secrets are not inherited
The AppContainer retains zero network capabilities
Existing suspended-launch, AppContainer-token verification, pre-resume Job membership, bounded I/O, timeout, descendant lifecycle, and verified termination guarantees remain intact
Any temporary ACL or security-state mutation is deterministic, test-owned, and cleaned up without broadening unrelated resources
No generic executable registry, Git mutation, browser/UI, elevation, approval bypass, or persistent approval reuse is introduced

acceptance.claim: Native Windows exact-head tests prove a zero-capability AppContainer child can read a deterministic fixture inside one explicit test-owned trusted workspace after the minimum stable-Windows workspace grant is applied.
Native Windows exact-head tests prove the contained child can create or modify a deterministic test-owned file inside that workspace and the host can verify the expected result.
The same contained identity remains denied access to a test-owned sibling resource outside the workspace and SG-000012 Cotra protected-state/authority-channel isolation remains green.
The implementation does not grant broad user-profile access, caller-selected ACL authority, network capability, additional executable authority, or public PowerShell authority.
Workspace grant setup and cleanup are deterministic and bounded to test-owned resources, with failure paths preserving fail-closed behavior.
SG-000011 descendant-aware lifecycle and SG-000013 bounded PowerShell containment regressions remain green under the workspace-authority qualification.
Exact-head Windows/Ubuntu Rust, Node, Governance, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, exact-diff security review, and zero unresolved blocking review threads all pass.

done_when: Workspace-scoped AppContainer read/write authority is proven on native Windows with negative isolation regressions, merged and post-merge verified, while public PowerShell and broader process/filesystem authority remain absent.

canonical_evidence.native_windows: SUCCESS: the zero-capability AppContainer child read the deterministic input and created the deterministic output only inside the explicitly granted test-owned workspace, remained denied the deterministic sibling resource, observed NUL/EOF stdin, received no tested Cotra/API secret-like variables, and reached verified Job quiescence; SG-000012 and SG-000013 regressions remained green.
canonical_evidence.jev: PASSED: 2/2 hunks, zero findings, zero blocking findings
canonical_evidence.ocr: PASSED: Open Code Review v1.12.9 exact-range delegation, 2 files total, 1 reviewable, 1 excluded unsupported_ext and manually reviewed
canonical_evidence.security_review: PASS on exact qualified head; temporary ACL grant is test-owned, workspace-scoped, explicitly restored, and introduces no public authority delta
canonical_evidence.authority_boundary: No new public authority. Public powershell.run remains absent and Windows public process.spawn remains restricted to the exact SG-000010-qualified %SystemRoot%\System32\whoami.exe target; caller-selected ACL authority, broad filesystem grants, generic executable-registry widening, process network, detached/background execution, public kill, Git mutation, browser/UI automation, elevation, and approval bypass/reuse remain absent.
